juliobsz-skills-awwwards.description: Build award-caliber websites from a one-line prompt such as "make me a portfolio, my name is Ana". Uses the bar of sites that win Awwwards Site of the Day as a quality standard. Covers concept, art direction, typography, motion choreography, WebGL, page transitions, real content, SEO, accessibility and performance, then visual QA in a browser. Next.js by default, Astro for animation-heavy static showcases, or the stack the project already uses. juliobsz-skills-jury.description: Score any website the way an Awwwards jury would, from evidence alone. Screenshots every page type on desktop, a throttled phone and reduced motion, measures LCP, CLS, FPS, axe, keyboard focus and hover feedback, audits SEO and metadata, then a fresh critic that never sees the code scores Design, Usability, Creativity, Content and the six developer areas, with a ranked fix list.
